newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle trade steady at $64.00 - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle trade steady at $64.00 - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle traded steady at $64.00 per cwt on a live basis, while dressed bids of $103.00 to $104.00 were passed, Nebraska sources said.
Many showlists were cleaned up after active trading Tuesday. Some of Tuesday's sales were delivered and slaughtered later that day, and more were delivered to packing plants Wednesday morning.
"There has been a considerably earlier shipment than we have seen in a couple of months," a source said.
Of the 61,300 head sold in Nebraska Tuesday, sources said about 12,000 had been shipped to packers by Wednesday morning.
